description:
The `UpsertAsset` function at download_service.go:596 hardcodes `variant_key = 'default'` in the INSERT VALUES clause, blocking multi-channel releases.

Fix:
1. Add `VariantKey string` field to the `DownloadAsset` struct.
2. Replace the hardcoded `'default'` with a parameterized value.
3. S2D's upload flow passes `channelToVariantKey(channel)` when constructing the asset.
4. The existing `channelToVariantKey()` function (update_handlers.go:50-55) already handles the mapping correctly and can be reused or moved to a shared location.
name: lpbs-upsert-asset-hardcoded-variant-key
title: Remove Hardcoded Variant Key In LPBS UpsertAsset
